player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} ({role}) in a {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies game.
- Each round, submit [heads] or [tails] (or [h], [t]).
- If your choice matches your opponent’s, Player 0 wins the round; otherwise Player 1 wins.
Reply with your choice in the format '[heads]' or '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ၼႃႉတီႈပွင်ႈလႅၼ်ႈ ဢမ်ႇပေႃးလီ၊ တႃႇတေႁပ်ႉ/submit ၸွမ်း '[heads]' ဢမ်ႇၼၼ် '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 လႆႈၶဝ်ႈၸူး '{choice0}'၊ Player 1 လႆႈၶဝ်ႈၸူး '{choice1}'။ Match -> Player 0 ဢၼ်ၸွႆႈထိုင်
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.

outcome.p0_wins: Dai shaloi, player 0 gaw raundi law htum lu ai.
